ruleDefinitions.name: Potential CobaltStrike Process Patterns
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential process patterns related to Cobalt Strike beacon activity

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX("cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/C\\ whoami$") AND parent_process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Temp\\\\")) OR ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\runonce\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\dllhost\\\.exe$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/c\\ echo.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\>\\ \\\\\\\\\\\.\\\\pipe.*"))) OR ((parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/C\\ echo.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\>\\ \\\\\\\\\\\.\\\\pipe.*")) AND process_command_line = RGX("conhost\\\.exe\\ 0xffffffff\\ \\-ForceV1$")) OR (parent_process_command_line = RGX("\\/C\\ whoami$") AND process_command_line = RGX("conhost\\\.exe\\ 0xffffffff\\ \\-ForceV1$")))
